author: ThatWeird1
body:
ThatWeird1
Banned?
Uh... Yesterday I asked for an appeal and the of the Senior Moderator, LegendaryEngram, and the same person that banned me the first time, rebanned me this morning, not long after the original banned was lifted. I was not on the server at the tie of the ban, and once again it was for hacking which I have no knowledge of. If any is evidence is needed, then it is simply that I have not been on the server since I was originally banned. Nor was I on the server at the time of the second banning. I'm simply posting this because of my confusion and I would love to get back to playing with my friends on Avicus.  I appologize for any confusion on the moderator's part if i was the cause, but i can promise i am just as confused if not more so than they.  Once again I just want to get back to playing...

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

After appealing your ban I was contacted by the mod who banned with video evidence.

So I told the mod to re-ban you.  As of right now you will not be appealed. You can appeal at a later date.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
